title: PH, Australia to hold live-fire drill off Eastern Samar town

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Mariners and other sea users have been advised to avoid a designated coastal area off Taft, Eastern Samar, on Nov. 8 as the Philippine Army and Australian Defence Force (ADF) conduct a live-fire exercise as part of their joint military training. In a navigational warning issued by the local Coast Guard Office on Thursday, the live-fire exercise will take place off Barangay Polangi, Taft, from 8 a.m. to noon on Sunday, Nov.8. A temporary exclusion zone at sea will be established around the designated exercise area to ensure the safety of vessels and other watercraft during the military […]...
